observations: The official project describes VT Code as an open-source Rust terminal coding agent.
The Configure example shows vtcode init scaffolding project configuration and AGENTS.md, with a reminder to review before committing.
The Commands list defines vtcode review as an agent review of uncommitted changes.
Why VT Code describes command policy and sandboxing at the execution boundary, and inspecting edits with turn diffs.
limits: The README describes features; it does not prove every deployment forces human review or prevents data leaks.
No benchmark, runtime measurement, or hardware claim is made in this article.
The Hacker News posting date is discovery metadata, not the official source update date.
